viewport.label: phone-half
viewport.hint: roughly HALF of a phone screen (very little vertical room)

summary: The viewport suffers from layout overlap where the floating transport bar obscures command list content, along with bi-directional text truncation artifacts in file items.

issues.title: Transport bar occludes command content
issues.description: The floating transport bar overlays the command component list and active playback status line due to limited vertical space.
issues.evidence: The 'الملفات الأخيرة' header and audio track status text are clipped and partially hidden behind the transport bar card.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom scroll padding or dock the transport bar to prevent content obstruction.

issues.title: LTR string truncation defect in RTL layout
issues.description: Mixed-direction folder names truncate awkwardly at the start of LTR strings instead of using end-truncation.
issues.evidence: Ellipsis appears at the start of '...d_Guidelines_and_Identity_System_01' and '... Q4 Product Shoot'.
issues.suggestion: Enforce consistent text direction isolation and proper text-overflow truncation for mixed-directional labels.
